translation.name: Jamaw ta Marbinto: Kabarre ta Gala ɗo bi ka Iisa Masi iŋ daŋla

book.name: Hebru
book.title: Hebru Maktumne taat ŋu siirtu ɗo gee ku Hebru

content: Satkin ta Iisa Masi taat mena rakki di

Ka seener, *gaanuun ka Muusa, ŋaar ar kelimco di ta gamin kuuk yaa ase neginda. Kar gay, ŋa arro sawa-sawa iŋ gamin okin̰co kuuk goy kuwa-aku. Ampa-ak, ya gee gina *satkinkan ŋuur-ak di elgin iŋ elgina, ŋuur kuuk bariya botol a ŋuu sin̰je moota iŋ Buŋ-ak, gaanuun necaaɗo tuk, ŋaa ginin̰co ŋuu nece tak ar taat Buŋ rakiyo.
Yampa, ya satkinkan-ak nec ko ŋuu kuuniye *cawar ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi-ak, ŋuu ibinin cawirkuwco ho ŋuu rasin̰ satkinkan-aku.
Ka seener gay, satkinkan-ak, illa ŋu iyaag gee ay elgo, ŋu moyig zunuubinnico.
Asaan baar ku awgir iŋ ku barkiydi, ŋuur bal gine gudurre tak-tak taat ŋuu ace zunuubinna.
Ɗo saan taar-an ko, wiktin taat Iisa Masi rakiy ase ɗo duniiner, ŋa kaawiiji ɗo Buŋdi aman :

content.text: « Ki bal rake a ŋuun̰ gine satkine wala ŋuun̰ iye bere,
kar gay, ki pinig zir.
Ki aacayɗo iŋ satkin ta mallel taat ŋu eriyjiŋ
wala iŋ satkinkan kuuk ŋu gintu ɗo bi ka zunuubinnico.
Hiyya, nu kaawtu aman :
‟ Buŋdu ! Nun ko-aŋka.
Nu as gine maan kaak ki rakiyo.
Hii, nu as ar kaak ŋu siirtu ɗo bir ɗo Kitamner. ” »

content: Ɗo wer-ak, ŋa teestu ja kaawe aman : « Ki bal rake a ŋuun̰ gine satkinkan, ŋuun̰ iye bere, ŋuun̰ ere malle, ŋuun̰ bere satkine ɗo bi ka zunuubinnar. Kiŋ gay bal aaciye iŋ gamin-aŋku. » Kar sando, gaanuun ka Muusa kaaw a ŋuu ginin̰ gamin-aŋ okin̰co.
Kar ba aaro, *Masi kaawtu pey aman : « Buŋdu ! Nun ko aŋka. Nu as gine maan kaak ki rakiyo. » Wiktin taat ŋa kaawtu pa-ak, ŋa as deen̰ satkinkan kuuk awalle ho ŋaa makin̰ iŋ tan̰ji.
Ansii ko, iŋ niyin taat Buŋ ictu, Iisa Masi bertu ziy satkine mena rakki di gaasiititi a ŋaa acin̰ zunuubinnite, gii gine cawar ɗo uŋji.
Kun kawta, gay satkiner ku *Yuudinnar okin̰co gingiy riyco iŋ ka peyin̰co. Ŋu gingiy satkinkan ŋuur-ak di doo. Kar satkinkan-ak gay gedarro tak-tak imilin̰ zunuubinna ku geemir.
Kar Iisa Masi gay, satkiney tan̰ji, taar mena rakki di gaasiititi ho ta goy doo. Min ŋa berig ziy satkin ɗo zunuubinna ku geemir, ŋa daktu diy baay ka samaaner ɗo meeday ta Buŋdi.
Diŋ ŋa ƴoka a Buŋ yaaco nosire ɗo adiney, ŋuu gine wer ka lee asin̰ji.
Ampaa ko, iŋ satkiney taat mena rakki di-at, ŋa gintu a ŋuur kuuk ŋa ginaag cawar-ak yaa nece tak ɗo werco doo.
Taar-an ko taat Ruwwin ta Buŋdi oki kaawiite. Ta teestu ja kaawe aman :

content.text: « *Rabbin Buŋ kaaw aman :
‟ Ya menaw ŋuur-ak bire, naa obe jamaw iŋ ŋuura.
Ɗo jamaw-at, naa un̰jin̰ gaanuundu ɗo kaƴco
ho naa diyin̰ ɗo gelbinco. ”

content: Ŋa gaaytu pey aman :

content.text: ‟ Naaco saamiyin̰ nigin̰co okin̰ji
ho zunuubinnico gay, nu icaaɗo pey bico tak-tak. ”

content: Ka seener, ya zunuubinnico kat ŋu saamiycogu, satkinkan bal gine pey galilco.
Diye ka gelbiner iŋ Buŋ
Ampa-ak, gem kol siŋtay, iŋ baar ku Iisa kuuk ŋa bertu satkin-ak, gi gin botol taat gii un̰je ɗo wer kaak *cawar aale-aka.
Iŋ ziy ka meen̰ji, ŋa pilte botol taat gii aaɗe min ɗo maan kaak ar zimilla kuuk gootig wer kaak cawar aale-aka. Botol taat ŋa piltu-at, taar marbinto ho ta bera goye kaak taɓ.
Ansi-ak, gi gin *mee satkiner ka tatko kaak tala ɗo kaay ka *ger ka Buŋdi kaak kuwa ka samaaner.
Ampa-ak, sin̰jinte moota ɗo uŋji ka Buŋdi iŋ gelbin rakki bal kolaw ɗo saan ta imaante. Sin̰jinte iŋ gelbin kaak ac min pikirre taat jookumo ho iŋ ziŋka kuuk ac iŋ amay kuuk cawar.
Obinte tirit ɗo maan kaak gi eriy iŋ imaante ho gi gaariy-aka, asaan Buŋ necaat tak taat ŋa kaawtu.
Bariyinte botol taat gii iskiguwe ziŋkite a gii elguwe benannite ho gii ginguwe gamin kuuk samaane.
N̰uminte kaak gi n̰umgiy-aŋ, dakinte rasin̰jiɗo ar gee daarin̰ rasiyo. Kar gay, iskinte ziŋkite ɗo imaan ho gininte gaay iŋ gaayo, asaan ku iban ko kadar ƴiriy ta *Rabbiner, taar gaay ko.
Ya waan ibingit seen ta Buŋdi kat ŋa wakila gine zunuubinna iŋ niyiney, ginno pey satkin ta saamiye zunuubinnar.
Waanna-ak, taat ɗakji-at, illa ŋaa ere iŋ kolaw ƴiriy taat Buŋ yaa ɗukume seriine. Ƴiriy taar-at, ak taat girzan̰-at yaa idin̰ jot, ŋuur kuuk newsiji kop ɗo Buŋdi.
Ŋaar kaak n̰epiɗig *gaanuun kaak Muusa siirtu, ŋuu deen̰ji bal kaawo ya saadinna seer wal subba goya.

Kar ɗo taŋkoŋ gay, ŋaar kaak ƴilaag Roŋ ka Buŋdi, kaak talaag baar ku Iisa ar ŋu maan kaak maala ho kaak ginaat bees Ruwwin ta Buŋdi taat bera barkine, ku pakarro kadar tan̰ji-at yaa gine raɗ paka wal maman ? Baar ku Iisa, ŋu ŋuur ɗoo di baar ku jamaw ta marbinto kuuk ginig gee cawar-aku ?
Ka seener, gi ibingig ŋaar kaak kaaw aman : « Ŋa nun meendu kat yaa yeepin taat ŋu nigtu. Ŋa nun meendu kat yaa kappiyin kaaco ɗo taat ŋu gintu. »
Kar ŋa ɗiytu pey aman : « *Rabbin Buŋ yaa ɗukume seriin ɗo geen̰ji. »
Raɗji aale ɗo ŋaar kaak gal ɗo pise ka Buŋ kaak goy mento !
Kar gay pakiroŋ ɗo goyiŋko kaak awalle wiktin taat Buŋ piliig kaƴko. Ɗo menaw ŋuur-ak, gee taaɓiyiŋko dakina ho iŋ taaɓin taat ginko dakin-at oki, kuŋ gay subire.
Werin daarin̰, ŋu wariŋko ho ŋu taaɓiyiŋko ɗo uŋco ka geemir. Kar werin daarin̰ gay, ku galiy uciy iŋ ŋuur kuuk ŋu taaɓiyaag pa.

Ka seener gay, taaɓin ta ŋuur kuuk ŋu taaɓiyaag ɗo daŋaayner, ku aawaat ɗo ziŋkiko ho wiktin taat ŋu sokiig gaminko, ku rascog iŋ aditko kuuk portiko. Aditko portik-ak asaan ku ibin kadar ku gin gamin kuuk samaan paka ho kuuk yaa taaye doo.
Ampa-ak, maan kaak ku eriy iŋ imaan-ak, dakoŋ rasin̰jiɗo. Asaan iŋ ŋaar ko, kuu gasin haginko dakina.
Ya ku raka necin taat Buŋ rakiyo ho kuu gasin̰ maan kaak ŋa kaawtu a ŋaako bere-ak, illa kuu ice subirraw ho kuu goye bombo.
Kitamne kaaw aman :

content.text: « Pey ɗak mena sooɗ di, sooɗ tak-tak
ek di, ŋaar kaak yaa ase-ak, yaa ase.
Ŋa taayaaɗo.
Gem kaak jaawa uŋtu iŋ botol
yaa goye ɗo saan ta imaanji.
Kar ŋaar kaak yeepa aar gay,
adir ginaaɗo gal iŋ ŋaara. »

content: Ɗo tanteŋ gay, gi attanno iŋ gee kuuk yeepa aaro ho ɓaayiy tare ziŋkico-aku. Kar gay, gi atta iŋ ŋuur kuuk diya gelbinco iŋ Buŋ a ŋuu gase jile.
